display.purpose: Hero-scale headlines on marketing/landing surfaces only.

title.purpose: Card/component headers, nav labels, button labels.

label.purpose: Strengths/weaknesses headers, table column labels, form field labels. Never as a kicker above a section h2 — see Do's and Don'ts.

caption.purpose: The dashboard's real default for secondary detail text — card metadata, list-item subtext, helper copy.

caption-lg.purpose: Slightly larger secondary text, e.g. helper copy under a primary input.

micro.purpose: The smallest step — inline badges, a stat's unit label, a timestamp in a tight row.

data.purpose: Every number, ID, URL, and score — no exceptions.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button and logo mark — marks the one recommended action.

shadows.name: cyan
shadows.purpose: Cyan-accented elements needing the same halo treatment as glow.

shadows.name: score-ring-blur
shadows.value: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation=6 (SVG filter, not a CSS box-shadow)
shadows.purpose: Glows the score ring's progress arc procedurally — the one place glow is generated rather than a static token.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: Reveal transition for expanding content, e.g. an opened module card.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals and animated counters across the system (score ring count-up, score bar fill).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a view. Permanent violet glow, not just on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4A2FD6; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,92,255,0.35), 0 0 48px -12px rgba(124,92,255,0.55); transition: all 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(124,92,255,0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(124,92,255,0.35), 0 0 48px -12px rgba(124,92,255,0.55); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined, lower-emphasis action alongside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #12161F; color: #EAEEF7; font: 600 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #1C212D; transition: all 200ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(124,92,255,0.5); background: rgba(18,22,31,0.7); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Semantic tag built from the Tint Formula Rule — 30% border, 10% background, full-strength text.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 10px; font: 500 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid; } .ds-pill-good { border-color: rgba(52,211,153,0.3); background: rgba(52,211,153,0.1); color: #34D399; } .ds-pill-bad { border-color: rgba(248,113,113,0.3); background: rgba(248,113,113,0.1); color: #F87171; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat, glass surface — hairline border and blur, deliberately no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(13,16,24,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid #1C212D; border-radius: 18px; padding: 20px; } .ds-eyebrow { font: 600 11px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; color: #5A6377; } .ds-card-value { margin-top: 12px; font: 600 30px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #EAEEF7; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Deliberate exception to the dark palette: white-filled for legibility, not dark-on-dark. Used across every themed form, including the full auth family.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { font: 400 14px/1 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #8E97AC; } .ds-input { margin-top: 8px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #1C212D; background: #fff; color: #0f172a; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(124,92,255,0.7); }

narrative.overview: This is a mission-control read on real business data, not a generic SaaS admin theme. The canvas is near-black (void, #05060A) with two faint radial glows fixed in the upper corners — the only ambient light source on an otherwise flat, quiet field. Surfaces are separated by hairline borders and light backdrop blur rather than drop shadows; nothing here pretends to float above a desk. Color is spent deliberately: a single violet accent (iris) carries every primary action, and a single cyan (neon) is reserved specifically for data and metadata — never for decoration. Glow marks real signal — a primary action, a live score — and appears nowhere else. Every number, ID, URL, and score sets in JetBrains Mono, so the eye can tell measured fact from written copy at a glance before reading either.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black flat canvas with two fixed ambient glows, never a busy background
One accent for action (iris), one accent for data (neon), both used sparingly
Hairline borders + blur define surfaces; shadows are reserved for real signal
JetBrains Mono for every number, ID, URL, and score — no exceptions
Semantic color (good/warn/bad/info) always follows the same tint formula, never a solid fill

rules.name: The Tint Formula Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color (iris, neon, and all four signal colors) appears as a pill/badge in exactly one shape: ~30%-opacity border, ~10%-opacity background, full-strength text. A solid fill is reserved for the primary button and the score ring/bar only.

rules.name: The One Accent, One Job Rule
rules.body: Iris means "act on this." Neon means "this is data." Don't swap their roles or introduce a third general-purpose brand accent.

rules.name: The Monospace Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number, ID, URL, and score sets in JetBrains Mono, even mid-sentence inside otherwise-Inter text. A stray sans-serif digit reads as a typo in this system.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow never means "this is important content." It means "this is live, active, or the one recommended action." Reserve it for the score ring, the primary CTA, and comparable live-state indicators.

dos: Do reserve glow for elements carrying real, live signal — never as generic hover decoration on an ordinary card.
Do build every semantic color as border/background/text per the Tint Formula Rule.
Do set every number, ID, URL, and score in JetBrains Mono, even mid-sentence.
Do use the 1px hairline border as the default way to separate two surfaces.
Do keep generated client websites out of this system entirely — they are an intentionally separate, light-themed world.
donts: Don't reintroduce Tailwind's stock violet-* or cyan-* utility classes — they are undefined in this project and will silently render as nothing.
Don't add a generic drop shadow to a .card for a "lift" effect — cards are deliberately flat/glass.

Don't style a form's surrounding chrome (card, labels, headings, links) with raw slate-* Tailwind colors — the one deliberate exception is the input fill itself, which is white with slate-900 text by design.
